author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be some serious wins in our community. Gamers and people interested in computers have had a rough year with everything getting more pricier. Now it seems the bubble around AI is actually on the verge of deflating and it means that for once we may actually see this madness come to it's end. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: We're Fighting Back and Actually Winning...
